subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the cute chibi character in <Picture 1>, featuring a round squishy 3D-modeled body, big expressive eyes, and a fluffy furry tail. The character is approximately half the height of the cup in the scene.
<Subject 2> is the tabletop scene in <Picture 2>, featuring a flat surface with a cup positioned in the frame, providing the environment and spatial layout for the animation.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a single continuous long-take 3D animation showing <Subject 1> interacting with the cup in <Subject 2>. The character bumps the cup, gets frustrated trying to push it, jumps inside, causes it to tip over and empty all its water, climbs out, and finally leaps at the camera. The character vocalizes in a cute anime-loli voice throughout the unbroken shot.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the character's round squishy 3D body, big expressive eyes, fluffy furry tail, and proportions from <Picture 1> are retained throughout the continuous take.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the tabletop surface and cup from <Picture 2> remain present and visible throughout the entire sequence; the cup never disappears from frame.

detailed_description:
The target video is a single continuous long take rendered in a realistic 3D modeling style with soft studio lighting. The character exhibits a QQ-bouncy, jelly-like physics with exaggerated squash-and-stretch animation, a fluffy furry tail with visible individual hair strands, and rich facial expressions. The character is approximately half the height of the cup. The cup remains visible and physically present in every frame; the character never transforms into a sphere; no mechanical structures such as fan blades appear anywhere in the scene.

[Shot 1] The camera begins in a medium tracking shot on the tabletop environment of <Subject 2>, holding the cup in the left-center of the frame. <Subject 1>, the round squishy character from <Picture 1>, enters from the right side of the frame, strutting confidently with a big swaggering gait while her fluffy tail swishes proudly behind her. She bumps directly into the cup with her forehead. The cup wobbles slightly on the surface. The impact sends <Subject 1> bouncing backward from the recoil, her QQ-bouncy body compressing and rebounding as she topples onto her back. <Subject 1> (S1) lets out a small surprised yelp in a cute high-pitched anime-loli voice, <d>[Chinese] 呜！</d> Her eyes spin in dizziness and her tongue pokes out. The camera tilts down and pushes in slightly as she raises her left paw to rub her forehead with a teary-eyed expression. She pushes herself upright, her body jiggling, and her expression shifts to irritation. She stomps her foot twice, her fluffy tail swishing rapidly in an angry rhythm, and huffs, <d>[Chinese] 哼！</d> The camera pulls back to a medium shot as she marches straight toward the cup with a determined scowl. She places both paws against the cup and pushes left, her body squishing against the surface, but the cup does not move. She repositions, turning sideways to push with her shoulder, then turns around to push backward with her bottom, her fluffy tail pressed flat against the cup. The cup remains completely stationary. <Subject 1> (S1) grunts with effort in her cute loli voice, <d>[Chinese] 嗯...！嗯...！</d> Her expression cycles to intense frustration. She stomps her foot again, takes several quick bouncy steps backward, and crouches low. The camera tracks her as she sprints forward, her tiny legs pumping. As she reaches the cup, she leaps upward in a high jump with a clear arc and visible squash-and-stretch. The camera tilts up to follow her flight and then tilts down as she lands directly inside the cup with a small splash, shouting, <d>[Chinese] 呀！</d> The camera stays close to the cup as she flails inside, her fluffy tail sticking up and shaking water droplets. The cup rocks left and right from her thrashing, tilting further until it tips over completely, falling toward the camera. The camera dollies back slightly and tilts down as the cup lands on its side with its mouth facing directly toward the lens, remaining fully visible and intact. As the cup falls, all the water inside spills out completely in a large splash across the tabletop, leaving the interior of the cup entirely empty with absolutely no water remaining inside. <Subject 1> climbs out from the empty cup opening, her fur soaked. She stands on the tabletop and rapidly shakes her fluffy tail and head in a high-speed vibration, sending water droplets flying. Once dry, she turns and looks directly into the camera lens. Her expression is blank for a brief moment, then her eyes narrow and her cheeks puff out in sudden intense fury. She crouches slightly, her body compressing like a spring, and launches upward and forward in a single powerful bouncy hop directly at the camera. The jump has a clear physical arc; she does not fly or glide. She impacts the camera lens directly. The camera is struck and tumbles backward, the background rotating wildly in a continuous motion until the spinning slows and the final frame settles on a view of the ceiling above.

overall_soundscape:
Soft indoor room tone with the faint sound of tiny feet pattering on the tabletop surface. Light impact sounds when the character bumps the cup and lands in it. A large splash of water emptying completely from the cup when it tips over. Subtle bouncy rubber-like sound effects accompanying the character's squash-and-stretch movements.

non_diegetic_music:
A playful, light-hearted orchestral score at a moderate tempo with pizzicato strings, xylophone accents, and comedic woodwind stings that punctuate each action beat, swelling slightly during the sprint-and-jump sequence and resolving with a sudden comedic halt when the camera is struck.
